ns2:section.sectionText: Center for Innovation in Teaching & Learning (CITL) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.citl.illinois.edu. Video lectures, course materials, and a discussion board will be made available online through CITES Wiki (http://wiki.cites.uiuc.edu). Students are expected to complete online assignments and examinations on ACE Organic (https://ace.chem.illinois.edu) as outlined in the syllabus. Discussion sessions will be conducted online using Blackboard Collaborate at the indicated time (link to be provided). Participation in the live discussion session is recommended; discussions will also be recorded and archived online.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC or NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $387.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $353.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
